report.answer_text:
The original *Rugrats* had 9 seasons. It ran for 172 episodes across nine seasons, and the final episode aired on August 1, 2004.[1]
There is also a 2021 reboot. Wikipedia lists it with 3 seasons, running from May 27, 2021 to April 14, 2023.[2] It premiered on Paramount+. Together, the two series come to 12 seasons.
The sequel series *All Grown Up!* is separate. It had five seasons and 55 episodes.[3]
